hook: Suh spent over 23 years at IBM, rising to head global strategic partnerships worth more than $10 billion before leading Watson AI product units in commerce, supply chain and collaboration; she then served as President of DocuSign and on its board through its 2018 IPO before becoming CEO of Niantic Spatial, a company building real-world foundation models for physical AI.
name: Inhi Cho Suh

quote.text: Inhi is bridging the gap between digital AI and physical AI for complex work in the real world.

timeline.impact: Leads product management and strategy for database, data warehouse and information integration for over 12 years
Runs P&L for IBM's big data software portfolio including Hadoop and stream computing

timeline.event: Vice President, Strategy and Business Development, IBM
timeline.impact: Leads over $18 billion in IBM Analytics portfolio investments, mergers and acquisitions, including the Weather Company acquisition

timeline.event: General Manager, Watson Work and Collaboration Applications, IBM
timeline.impact: Runs global P&L for IBM's collaboration software business unit
Serves on the board through DocuSign's 2018 IPO and beyond

timeline.event: General Manager, Watson Customer Engagement Applications, IBM
timeline.impact: Leads Watson applications for marketing technology, e-commerce and digital supply chain

timeline.event: Head of Global Strategic Partnerships, IBM
timeline.impact: Leads business development covering more than $10 billion in revenue with major technology and consulting partners
Serves as a Section 16 officer leading product, engineering, design, customer support, CISO and channels
Serves on the board through Coda's 2025 merger with Grammarly
Leads a San Francisco Bay Area company building real-world foundation models for people, AI and robots

quick_facts: CEO of Niantic Spatial since March 2026, building real-world foundation models for physical AI

JD, North Carolina Central University School of Law; BS, Duke University
